name: 4DGS v2 Spacetime Loader
definition: A loading strategy for `.4dsplat` v2 files that stores one static gaussian set plus dynamic trajectories (birth/death/per-control-point positions). The static canvas paints as bytes arrive, tracks activate when the stream completes, and playback interpolates continuously on the GPU.
summary: The 4DGS v2 Spacetime Loader parses .4dsplat v2 files by separating scenes into a static canvas and dynamic tracks, enabling continuous GPU interpolation and efficient streaming for camera-aware motion clips.
